  WHY: The reviewer says the tuple change is a no-op for that `.md` path, while the line 90 change causes the workspace failure.

- Requirement: "Add a regression test that a dispatched run's reviewer workspace is the PR-head checkout." (from issue #5824)
  Expected change site: tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py — a test that exercises the gate-resolved `review_checkout_sha` end-to-end and asserts the `Checkout repo` step uses it

The gate-output wiring at review_autofix.yml:296 (`review_checkout_sha: ${{ steps.evaluate.outputs.review_checkout_sha }}`) and the env export at line 2426 (`REVIEW_CHECKOUT_SHA: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.review_checkout_sha }}`) are unverified by any test that exercises the actual `actions/checkout@v5` invocation. The PR's own acceptance criterion — "A `workflow_dispatch` review of a PR whose head adds a file sees that file in the reviewer workspace" — has no end-to-end test that drives `workflow_dispatch` through a real `actions/checkout@v5` call against a fabricated head SHA. The structural assertion in `test_dispatch_checkout_file_read_uses_head_not_default_branch` performs the checkout manually but never ties it back to the gate export.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

  Evidence of absence: The fragment exists at the right path but its body — per the visible diff (`<!-- changelog: security -->` marker, 6 lines total) — lacks the mandatory structure from CLAUDE.md §20.D: no headline sentence naming what shipped and the main user-visible change, no lead paragraph of 3-5 sentences, no "The numbers that matter" table (real measurable details are available: `review_checkout_sha` gate output, `REVIEW_CHECKOUT_SHA` env, `AUTOFIX_STALE_BASE_SKIP` exit code), no "What this means for <audience>" paragraph. The §20.G template requires all four sections; the shipped fragment has the headline compressed into the marker line and a single-sentence summary. The §20.E voice rules also require concrete workflow names, paths, and numbers — none appear.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
